GRADE 4 SOCIAL STUDIES — TERM 2 EXAM

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
Time: 48 minutes

INSTRUCTIONS
1. Answer all questions.
2. Use neat handwriting.
2. For multiple choice, write the correct letter only.
3. For short answers, write clearly in the spaces provided.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A: Multiple Choice

1. About Population Distribution in your school compound, which statement is correct?
   A. describe patterns of population distribution in the county,
   B. Learners should ignore Population Distribution completely.
   C. Population Distribution is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Population Distribution.

2. About Population Distribution around your home, which statement is correct?
   A. illustrate the patterns of population distribution in the county,
   B. Learners should ignore Population Distribution completely.
   C. Population Distribution is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Population Distribution.

3. About Population Distribution in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. describe patterns of population distribution in the county,
   B. Learners should ignore Population Distribution completely.
   C. Population Distribution is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Population Distribution.

5. About Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. at the market in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. identify aspects of traditional culture in the county,
   B. Learners should ignore Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. completely.
   C. Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County..

6. About Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. using objects in your classroom, which statement is correct?
   A. illustrate aspects of traditional culture practised in the county,
   B. Learners should ignore Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. completely.
   C. Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County..

7. About Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. when counting items at home, which statement is correct?
   A. identify aspects of traditional culture in the county,
   B. Learners should ignore Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. completely.
   C. Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County..

9. About The School in your school compound, which statement is correct?
   A. narrate the history of the school,
   B. Learners should ignore The School completely.
   C. The School is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise The School.

10. About The School around your home, which statement is correct?
   A. explain the values of the school,
   B. Learners should ignore The School completely.
   C. The School is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise The School.

11. About The School in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. recite the school motto,
   B. Learners should ignore The School completely.
   C. The School is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise The School.

13. About Economic activities in the County at the market in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. Explore the main resources found in the county,
   B. Learners should ignore Economic activities in the County completely.
   C. Economic activities in the County is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Economic activities in the County.

14. About Economic activities in the County using objects in your classroom, which statement is correct?
   A. identify the main economic activities carried out in the county,
   B. Learners should ignore Economic activities in the County completely.
   C. Economic activities in the County is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Economic activities in the County.

15. About Economic activities in the County when counting items at home, which statement is correct?
   A. explain the importance of economic activities carried out in the county,
   B. Learners should ignore Economic activities in the County completely.
   C. Economic activities in the County is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Economic activities in the County.

17. About Industries in the County at the market in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. identify industries in the county,
   B. Learners should ignore Industries in the County completely.
   C. Industries in the County is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Industries in the County.

18. About Industries in the County using objects in your classroom, which statement is correct?
   A. explain the benefits of industries in the county,
   B. Learners should ignore Industries in the County completely.
   C. Industries in the County is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Industries in the County.

19. About Industries in the County when counting items at home, which statement is correct?
   A. locate industries in the county
   B. Learners should ignore Industries in the County completely.
   C. Industries in the County is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Industries in the County.

21. About Enterprise Project at School in your school compound, which statement is correct?
   A. identify the projects that can be initiated at school,
   B. Learners should ignore Enterprise Project at School completely.
   C. Enterprise Project at School is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Enterprise Project at School.

22. About Enterprise Project at School around your home, which statement is correct?
   A. participate in initiating an enterprise project at school,
   B. Learners should ignore Enterprise Project at School completely.
   C. Enterprise Project at School is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Enterprise Project at School.

23. About Enterprise Project at School in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. identify qualities of a good citizen in school,
   B. Learners should ignore Enterprise Project at School completely.
   C. Enterprise Project at School is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Enterprise Project at School.

SECTION B: Short Answers
